title: High Exhaust Flue
summary: A soaring stone cavern at the northern peak of the mine. Giant iron chimney flues channel hot boiler exhaust into the dark above.
inspect_text: Riveted iron chimneys hiss with venting steam. The rock here is dry and hot, crusted with deposits of white chalk dust blown up from the deep stamp mills.
feature_inspect: Thick iron plates bolted together with heavy rivets. It vibrates with the steady pulse of boilers operating far below.

title: Deep Drainage Sump
summary: The southwestern terminus of the lower drifts. Warm, mineral-rich mine water pools in a wide stone basin beneath clanking pump rods.
inspect_text: Steam-driven reciprocating pumps draw chalky water out of the sump through perforated copper pipes. White sediment coats every timber support.
feature_inspect: A vertical walking-beam engine powered by overhead steam lines, driving pump buckets deep into the flooded sump.

title: Eastern Tailing Dump
summary: The southeastern corner of the workings opens into an immense cavern filled with mounds of crushed grey rock and glittering chalk fragments.
inspect_text: Wooden catwalks overhang vast tailing mounds left by the ore mills. Narrow-gauge tracks end here at iron dump bumpers.
feature_inspect: Heavy sheet iron stained with mineral wash, used to slide crushed gangue rock down into the lower abyss.

title: Lower Sluice Drift
summary: A low-ceilinged drift where muddy runoff flows along wooden sluice boxes lined with coarse canvas.
inspect_text: The canvas riffles catch heavy particles of raw chalk and quartz. Overhead steam pipes keep the water from freezing.
feature_inspect: Rough-sawn planks slick with fine white chalk slime.

title: Steam Drill Station
summary: The air is thick with chalk dust. A heavy rotary drill mounted on an iron screw-column bites into a pale rock seam.
inspect_text: Flexible canvas-braided steam hoses snake across the floor to power the chattering pneumatic chisel. Ear-splitting echoes linger.
feature_inspect: A brass-sleeved piston assembly with hardened steel drill bits.

title: Rotary Cutting Chamber
summary: Massive circular cutting heads with hardened teeth have gouged semicircular channels into the solid limestone.
inspect_text: Steam conduits hiss overhead. Deep cuts in the stone expose bright veins of luminescent chalk that glow with a faint pale violet light.
feature_inspect: The stone is cool and softly luminous, brittle to the touch and powdery.

title: West Timber Shoring
summary: Heavy square-cut pine timbers brace a fragile ceiling where the strata have sheared into jagged tiers.
inspect_text: Iron wedges and screw jacks reinforce the joints. White chalk dust clings to the rough bark like winter frost.
feature_inspect: Thick square balks of timber held under tons of mountain weight by iron turnbuckles.

title: Pneumatic Pipe Junction
summary: A hub of copper and iron pipelines bolted to the wall. Manometers click and flutter behind round glass bezels.
inspect_text: High-pressure steam and compressed air lines divide here, branching north toward the flue and east toward the village.
feature_inspect: Heavy brass turncocks with worn wooden handles, regulating pressure to the drills.

title: Raw Chalk Face
summary: A broad mining face where pickaxes and wedges have laid bare a pure bank of brilliant white chalk.
inspect_text: The chalk is chalky and brittle, but when touched with iron it hums with faint resonance. Broken fragments litter the track.
feature_inspect: A sheer wall of pure white chalk. Fine dust rises in small clouds at every step.

title: Ore Incline Station
summary: A busy transfer depot where steep cable rails lead up toward the village western terrace.
inspect_text: Empty wooden ore wagons wait on side spurs while loaded tubs are hitched to moving steel haulage ropes.
feature_inspect: A grooved iron drum wound with grease-stained steel cable, turned by an enclosed steam turbine.

title: High-Pressure Steam Vent
summary: A deafening hiss echoes through this narrow passage where an expansion joint on the main steam main vents excess pressure.
inspect_text: Clouds of damp white mist obscure the ceiling, condensation dripping down the walls in steady rivulets.
feature_inspect: A heavy brass spring-loaded relief valve releasing bursts of scalding white vapor.

title: Powder Magazine Drift
summary: A dry, reinforced dead-end passage barricaded by double sheet-iron doors marked with warning stencils.
inspect_text: Sealed copper canisters of blasting powder and fuses sit on raised wooden pallets, kept strictly dry away from steam drips.
feature_inspect: A heavy lead-lined iron box secured with a massive brass padlock.

title: Upper Chalk Gallery
summary: An elevated drift carved through a high shelf of mineralized chalk. The air is cooler here, smelling of dry dust.
inspect_text: Old hand-chiseled niches hold smoking grease lamps that cast flickering yellow light across glittering white walls.
feature_inspect: A hollow carved into the chalk wall holding a tin lamp with a sputtering wick.

title: Ventilation Shaft Head
summary: A wide vertical shaft drops into dark depths below, covered by an iron grating that vibrates with rising air currents.
inspect_text: A steam-driven squirrel-cage fan draws foul air up from the lower workings and exhausts it toward the northern chimney.
feature_inspect: A twelve-foot iron fan wheel spinning within a riveted shroud.

title: High Boiler Platform
summary: An iron gantry perched on stone ledges holds a secondary Scotch marine boiler wrapped in asbestos lagging.
inspect_text: Gauges show nominal boiler pressure. The furnace door glows cherry red through draft louvers, radiating intense heat.
feature_inspect: A horizontal cylindrical boiler with brass fittings and copper water-level tubes.

title: Chimney Catwalk
summary: A narrow steel mesh catwalk running along the rocky crags just below the apex exhaust flue.
inspect_text: Far below, the lights of the outer mine drift twinkle through rising plumes of warm steam and drifting white chalk specks.
feature_inspect: Sturdy tubular steel railing bolted directly into the cavern wall.

title: Flue Service Platform
summary: An iron staging platform overlooking the eastern bank of the main ventilation chimneys.
inspect_text: Maintenance tools, spare gaskets, and spanners hang on shadow boards beside grease-stained overalls.
feature_inspect: Rows of heavy forged wrenches and brass oil cans ready for chimney maintenance.

title: Condenser Station
summary: A maze of copper coil radiators where spent steam is cooled back into water for boiler feed tanks.
inspect_text: Trickling water splashes inside sheet-metal shrouds, keeping the air cool and humid.
feature_inspect: Long loops of ribbed copper pipe glistening with bead-like droplets of distilled water.

title: Steam Whistle Tower
summary: A raised stone outcrop supporting a three-chime brass steam whistle connected to shift-timer clockwork.
inspect_text: When triggered, its booming note echoes across all three concentric rings of the floor to signal shift changes.
feature_inspect: Three stepped brass bells linked by lever linkage to a heavy spring valve.

title: Upper Haulage Drift
summary: A wide, timbered passage with double iron track lines running downhill along the eastern slope.
inspect_text: Iron carts with flanged wheels roll by with a rhythmic metallic clatter, pushed by grease-coated conveyor cables.
feature_inspect: Stout iron rails spiked to oak cross-ties, polished smooth by countless ore wagons.

title: Winch Cable Hall
summary: A cavernous vault dominated by a massive twin-cylinder steam winding engine mounted on granite footings.
inspect_text: Heavy steel ropes sing with tension as they pull loaded ore rakes up from the eastern stope.
feature_inspect: Cast-iron engine bed supporting counter-weighted flywheels and gleaming brass piston rods.

title: Bright Chalk Seam
summary: The mining drift cuts through an exceptionally pure seam of chalk that shines with distinct inner light.
inspect_text: Miners' picks have left rhythmic cross-hatchings on the wall. Small powdery heaps of chalk crumble underfoot.
feature_inspect: A natural shelf where the chalk crystals exhibit high purity and pale luminescent luminescence.

title: East Rail Staging
summary: A bustling transit junction where eastern mining lines link with the approach to the village residential quarter.
inspect_text: Carts are shunted between sidings by burly workers with iron coupling bars. Lanterns glow red and green.
feature_inspect: A counter-weighted ground throw lever used to align the iron rail frogs.

title: Compressed Air Main
summary: A long straight drift carrying a twenty-inch riveted steel pneumatic main wrapped in tarred burlap.
inspect_text: The pipe thrums continuously with the pulse of surface-air compressors, supplying air to the deep stope drills.
feature_inspect: A huge riveted cylinder with expansion joints and brass pressure inspection ports.

title: Shored-Up Fault Drift
summary: A fractured section of cavern where a natural tectonic fault has been buttressed by thick iron I-beams.
inspect_text: Water seeps through hairline fissures, tasting faintly of sulfur and chalk minerals.
feature_inspect: Heavy rolled steel arches bolted to stone footers to arrest rock settlement.

title: Piston Pumping Floor
summary: Two horizontal steam pumps work in opposing tandem, their brass crossheads gliding along polished guide bars.
inspect_text: They suck water from the eastern drainage ditches and force it up to the central condensator tanks.
feature_inspect: A gleaming machine smelling of hot cylinder oil and clean steam.

title: Crushed Rock Chute
summary: A dusty loading bay where overhead bins discharge gravel and crushed chalk directly into hopper cars.
inspect_text: Operated by long wooden levers that open slide gates at the bottom of the timber funnels.
feature_inspect: A sliding steel gate operated by a counter-balanced hand lever.

title: Heavy Rail Yard
summary: A sprawling yard with four parallel tracks lined with heavy steel-sided hopper cars awaiting assembly into trains.
inspect_text: Brake wagons and flatcars loaded with fresh timbers stand ready for the night shift.
feature_inspect: A sturdy wooden wagon fitted with a hand-screw brake wheel and a red oil lantern.

title: Slag Runoff Drift
summary: The tunnel runs along a channel of dark vitrified slag from old smelting trials, cooled into glassy black ridges.
inspect_text: Chalk dust covers the black glassy stone like powdered sugar, crunched beneath heavy boots.
feature_inspect: Smooth, rippled black stone fused by ancient high heat before modern steam methods took over.

title: East Sump Drift
summary: A damp, cool passage draining seepage from the eastern tailing heaps toward the southern fault.
inspect_text: The floor is covered with duckboard walkways floating above six inches of milky, chalk-clouded water.
feature_inspect: Thick pine planks nailed together, sloshing gently as you tread on them.

title: Hydraulic Lift Basin
summary: A high-ceilinged cavern housing a water-hydraulic cargo platform used to hoist heavy equipment from lower cuts.
inspect_text: A massive brass-sleeved hydraulic ram glides into a vertical cylinder, driven by high-pressure accumulator tanks.
feature_inspect: A mirror-polished bronze ram standing thirty feet high within iron guide rails.

title: Deepest Chalk Stope
summary: The deepest working level of the chalk mine. The walls are pure blinding white, carved in stepped tiers.
inspect_text: Miners' chisels have squared the blocks with precision. The air is cool, still, and charged with static tingling.
feature_inspect: Evenly cut tiers of chalk stone, glowing with an inner luminescence.

title: Abyssal Rock Fault
summary: A yawning natural chasm cuts across the floor, bridged by heavy timber stringers and steel guard ropes.
inspect_text: Cool air currents rise from bottomless darkness below, carrying the faint sound of underground waterfalls.
feature_inspect: Heavy square balks bolted together with iron tie-rods, spanning the black gulf.

title: Submerged Rail Drift
summary: An abandoned rail line where iron tracks plunge under murky, chalk-white water.
inspect_text: Rusting wagons sit submerged to their axles, abandoned during a sudden underground water breakthrough.
feature_inspect: A wrought-iron cart sitting silently underwater, coated in lime and chalk scale.

title: South Drainage Sluice
summary: A wide masonry aqueduct carrying runoff water out of the mine, linking directly to the village drainage system.
inspect_text: Iron sluice gates with handwheel screws control the volume of water diverted into the communal cisterns.
feature_inspect: A massive bronze wheel operating a geared rack and pinion on the sluice gate.

title: The Deepest Cut
summary: The lowest point in the entire southern excavation. The ceiling vanishes into black shadows overhead.
inspect_text: Here the miners struck the Great Chalk Seam—a solid stratum of stone so luminous that miners work without lanterns.
feature_inspect: A monument of pure glowing stone. Looking at it gives a quiet sense of vast, unbroken peace.

title: Sluice Control Basin
summary: A deep circular settling basin where milky mine runoff drops its heavy chalk sediment before release.
inspect_text: Workers scrape the settled white paste into drying tubs to be baked into chalk blocks for the town.
feature_inspect: A stone weir with overflow notches that keep the chalk silt contained.

title: Geode Cavern
summary: The mine tunnel cuts directly through a hollow pocket lined with giant calcite and chalk crystals up to eight feet long.
inspect_text: The crystals chime with a faint resonant vibration when the distant steam engines stroke.
feature_inspect: Prismatic hexagonal pillars of luminous chalk growing in interlocking clusters.

title: Runoff Sluice Gallery
summary: A long vaulted corridor echoing with the rush of clean water flowing along stone channels.
inspect_text: Copper pipes run parallel to the water flume, feeding steam power to drainage pumps further west.
feature_inspect: Dressed stone blocks pointed with hydraulic mortar that resists water erosion.

title: Rock Tailing Dump West
summary: A secondary tailing dump where waste shale and quartz are stacked against cavern buttresses.
inspect_text: Old hand-barrows and broken shovel handles lie discarded among the grey rubble heaps.
feature_inspect: A splintered wooden cart with an iron hoop wheel, abandoned when a weld snapped.

title: Lower Rail Spur
summary: A quiet siding where miners leave their heavy coats and tin lunch pails on iron pegboards.
inspect_text: A small coke-fired brazier provides warmth for tired workers taking their brief ten-minute rest break.
feature_inspect: A perforated iron drum glowing with cherry-red coals, radiating welcome dry heat.

title: Sump Pump Station West
summary: The western auxiliary pumping vault, filled with the rhythmic thud-chunk of a Cornish beam pump.
inspect_text: A heavy wooden balance bob rocks up and down, lifting eighty gallons of water with every single stroke.
feature_inspect: A towering oak beam bound in wrought iron, rocking on massive trunnion bearings.

title: The Chalk Excavation Pit
summary: A massive open excavation pit where the richest chalk beds are mined in wide concentric steps.
inspect_text: Scores of workers once swung picks here under steam-lamp glare. The pit floor glows with soft, perpetual phosphorescence.
feature_inspect: Smooth white floor scarred by chisel marks, giving off a gentle, unwavering pale glow.

title: The Main Haulage Tracks
summary: A major railway junction where the eastern drifts converge. Overhead steam lines feed the electric arc lamps illuminating the switchyard.
inspect_text: Iron wagons roll constantly toward the tipples. Beneath a cast-iron drainage grating, a deep storm pipe gurgles with fast-running water.
feature_inspect: A heavy circular iron grating set into the floor. Peering through reveals a hollow conduit heading north under the military walls.

title: The Old Drainage Conduit
summary: A forgotten brick-and-iron storm drainage pipe running deep underneath the garrison foundations. Water sloshes to your ankles.
inspect_text: The air is damp and metallic. Farther in, an iron service ladder climbs up toward a round access hatch directly beneath the command tent.
feature_inspect: Rusty iron rungs anchored into the brick wall, ascending toward an overhead trapdoor.

title: North Approach Plaza
summary: A broad paved plaza at the northern apex of the village. Ahead, the massive iron-and-brass bulkhead of the military complex looms over the road.
inspect_text: Steam pipes run along high stone pylons to heat the open plaza. Armed guards look down from the garrison catwalks with ready crossbows.
feature_inspect: Smooth-worn granite cobbles flanked by copper gas-flambeaux.

title: Water Spring Terrace
summary: A tranquil corner where cold subterranean springs bubble from living rock into tiered stone basins.
inspect_text: Villagers fill brass canteens and wooden buckets. Overhead copper pipes radiate gentle warmth to keep the damp terrace comfortable.
feature_inspect: A natural moss-edged hollow in limestone overflowing with cold, clear drinking water.

title: South Overlook Terrace
summary: A high stone parapet at the southeastern tip of the village, looking down into the bustling eastern mining drifts.
inspect_text: A low stone wall keeps children safe from the drop. Lanterns flicker along the railing, overlooking the mine carts below.
feature_inspect: Solid limestone blocks cut with drainage scuppers, polished smooth by leaning elbows.

title: Wash Basin Terrace
summary: A communal stone terrace lined with laundry tubs fed by warm condensed-water pipes from the central boiler.
inspect_text: Lines of heavy canvas work-shirts and overalls hang drying in warm air rising from floor grates.
feature_inspect: A long zinc-lined stone trough filled with warm steaming water.

title: Steam Pipe Alley
summary: A narrow residential passage shadowed by thick overhead pipes wrapped in tarred canvas.
inspect_text: The pipes creak and tick with steam expansion. Front doors of stone cottages open directly into the warm lane.
feature_inspect: A ten-inch pipe fitted with brass bleed-valves venting gentle puffs of vapor.

title: Radiator Row
summary: A row of two-story miner cottages, their front walls fitted with heavy cast-iron radiators that heat the entire street.
inspect_text: Children sit on the warm radiator benches to play pebble-games, laughing in the gentle glow of gas lamps.
feature_inspect: An ornate fluted radiator radiating steady, dry heat into the lane.

title: Maryam's Apothecary
summary: A fragrant, orderly stone shop smelling intensely of eucalyptus, dried mint, and camphor balm.
inspect_text: Maryam works here behind rows of glass tincture bottles, compounding soothing lung-syrups for miners suffering from chalk dust.
feature_inspect: A heavy granite mortar filled with freshly crushed eucalyptus leaves and honey.

title: West Tool Shed
summary: A communal repair shed where miners sharpen drill steels and pickaxes on steam-turned emery wheels.
inspect_text: Showers of bright orange sparks illuminate the ceiling whenever a worker presses an edge against the spinning stone.
feature_inspect: A thick circular grindstone spinning smoothly via an overhead leather drive-belt.

title: Tariq's Clockwork Workshop
summary: A shop crammed with brass gears, clockwork escapements, aneroid manometers, and dissected steam valves.
inspect_text: Tariq sits at his high bench with magnifying loupes, delicate tweezers, and miniature soldering torches.
feature_inspect: A bench covered in tiny brass cogwheels, balance springs, and pressure diaphragms.

title: Gaslamp Lane
summary: A quiet, curving street lit by polished brass gas lamps mounted on wrought-iron wall brackets.
inspect_text: The gas flames burn with a calm, emerald-tinted white light, fueled by purified mine gas.
feature_inspect: A finely scrolled bracket holding a glass lamp housing a bright incandescent mantle.

title: Upper Residential Terrace
summary: A row of well-kept miner homes built into natural rock alcoves. Potted cave-ferns line the stone stair steps.
inspect_text: Quiet murmurs and the clinking of spoons against tin bowls drift from open windows.
feature_inspect: A clean scrubbed threshold flanked by potted white-cap ferns.

title: North Cliff Path
summary: A rising stone path chiseled into the cavern wall, offering a sweeping view across the entire village rooftops.
inspect_text: Iron railings guard the edge. The warm breeze carries the smell of fresh bread and coal smoke.
feature_inspect: Solid iron stanchions supporting a taut steel safety cable.

title: North Guard Slope
summary: A steep cobblestone ramp descending from the northern gate toward the eastern village artisan quarter.
inspect_text: Armed military sentries pace the wall above, keeping a watchful eye on every civilian who passes below.
feature_inspect: Heavy granite sets laid in fish-scale pattern to provide traction for loaded handcarts.

title: Iron Stair Landing
summary: A junction where several iron spiral staircases link the upper cliff terraces with the lower artisan lanes.
inspect_text: Cast-iron treads ring like muffled bells underfoot as workers run up and down between shifts.
feature_inspect: A central fluted cast-iron column supporting open-mesh spiral treads.

title: East Tenement Row
summary: Multi-story timber-and-stone tenements housing several dozen miner families. Washing lines crisscross overhead.
inspect_text: Small children peer from high balcony railings while neighbors converse across the narrow gap between eaves.
feature_inspect: Sturdy pine rail polished by generations of leaning forearms.

title: Weaver's Workshop
summary: A spacious workshop resounding with the rhythmic clack-thud of steam-powered fly-shuttle looms.
inspect_text: Spinning wheels and looms produce heavy duck canvas, filter veils for chalk dust, and durable denim trousers.
feature_inspect: A cast-iron loom frame with flying shuttles dancing across tight cotton warp threads.

title: East Pipe Junction
summary: A wide street intersection dominated by a freestanding iron gantry supporting district heating mains.
inspect_text: Valve wheels and steam traps hiss rhythmically as condensate is discharged into road gutters.
feature_inspect: Lattice-girder steel arch spanning the street carrying three parallel lagged pipes.

title: Miner Cottage Row East
summary: A tranquil cul-de-sac of whitewashed stone cottages with brass doorknobs and polished windowpanes.
inspect_text: Small brass nameplates beside front doors commemorate miner families who have lived here for generations.
feature_inspect: Engraved with family crests and decades of unbroken mining service.

title: Lantern Lane
summary: A cheerful market street where vendors set up trestle tables selling tin mugs, leather boots, and dried mushrooms.
inspect_text: Overhead festoon lanterns cast warm orange circles onto the wet cobblestones.
feature_inspect: Heavy wooden trestles displaying hand-stitched leather boots and tin mess kits.

title: Boiler Exhaust Lane
summary: A narrow alley flanked by the brick blast-walls of a district steam-boosting station.
inspect_text: The air is warm and dry, smelling faintly of clean mineral water and coal smoke.
feature_inspect: Solid red engineering brick tied together with heavy star-pattern iron wall washers.

title: East Cliff Terrace
summary: A scenic promenade overlooking the lower rail staging yards of the mine, lined with benches.
inspect_text: Off-duty miners sit here with clay pipes, watching the distant shunting of ore trains below.
feature_inspect: A curved oak bench bolted to the parapet, worn smooth by generations of workers.

title: Memorial Wall
summary: A somber stretch of cavern wall faced with polished slate tablets listing the names of miners lost in cave-ins.
inspect_text: Small oil lamps burn in carved recesses beneath the names. Fresh cavern ferns have been placed at the base.
feature_inspect: Dozens of names etched in gold leaf, commemorating those who fell in the lower drifts.

title: South Mushroom Lane
summary: A cool, quiet street running parallel to the agricultural mushroom caverns. The smell of damp loam is strong.
inspect_text: Wagons loaded with wooden compost flats rumble by, driven by quiet garden workers.
feature_inspect: A low-slung wooden wagon piled high with steaming, enriched cave loam.

title: Spore Drying Shed
summary: A ventilated wooden building where mature mushroom spores are dried on fine brass mesh racks.
inspect_text: Warm air is piped beneath the drying tables to dehydrate the harvest for winter storage.
feature_inspect: Tier upon tier of fine wire mesh dusted with velvety purple mushroom spores.

title: Stepped Mushroom Beds
summary: A vast vaulted chamber lined with terraced wooden beds blooming with thousands of white and blue edible caps.
inspect_text: Fine water misting nozzles spray the beds every ten minutes, powered by the village water line.
feature_inspect: Brass spray heads atomizing water into a cool, refreshing fog.

title: Southern Runoff Trench
summary: A deep, masonry-lined drainage channel dividing the agricultural zone from the residential terraces.
inspect_text: Iron footbridges cross the water at regular intervals, connecting lanes on either side.
feature_inspect: Graceful cast-iron arch with safety handrails spanning the rushing channel.

title: Root Cellar Vault
summary: A cool stone vault dug deep into living rock, used to store dried provisions, smoked fish, and root crops.
inspect_text: Heavy timber bins stand filled with pickled vegetables and wheel upon wheel of aged cave-cheese.
feature_inspect: Massive iron-strapped oak chest filled with wax-sealed root provisions.

title: Communal Steam Baths
summary: A pillared bathhouse with three stepped pools of hot, mineral-rich water fed directly by condensed steam lines.
inspect_text: Miners soak their aching joints here after hard ten-hour shifts, scrubbing off white chalk dust with pumice.
feature_inspect: Clear turquoise water steaming gently at a soothing temperature.

title: Condenser Cistern
summary: A massive cylindrical copper storage tank holding ten thousand gallons of purified drinking water.
inspect_text: A glass sight-tube shows the water level, while copper faucets allow villagers to draw water freely.
feature_inspect: A gleaming brass turn-handle faucet dripping into a carved stone basin.

title: Spring Intake Chamber
summary: A masonry vault surrounding the purest underground spring, fitted with charcoal and sand filtration beds.
inspect_text: The water runs crystal clear over white quartz pebbles before entering the village mains.
feature_inspect: Layers of graded quartz sand and activated charcoal filtering every drop.

title: The Village Square
summary: The beating heart of the village. A broad circular plaza paved in concentric stone rings, surrounded by gas lamps.
inspect_text: At the center, broad spiral stone stairs lead UP to the Floor 3 Heart-Pit ('oh'). A large iron hearth warms the crowd.
feature_inspect: Solid granite stairs ascending into the dark ceiling toward Floor 3.

title: Elder Rashid's Quarters
summary: A modest stone house lined with bookshelves, maps of the cavern system, and brass surveying instruments.
inspect_text: Elder Rashid sits here at a heavy oak desk, head in his hands, surrounded by official military decrees and the requisition roll for Zayd.
feature_inspect: A parchment document bearing Captain Malik's iron seal, demanding one youth as an offering.

title: Yasmin's Bakery
summary: A warm, flour-dusted bakery smelling wonderfully of fresh flatbread, sesame, and roasted dates.
inspect_text: A huge brick oven heated by copper steam coils dominates the back. Yasmin stands by the counter, tearful and furious over Zayd's capture.
feature_inspect: A massive domed brick hearth with steam pipes wrapping its base, baking scores of flatbreads.

title: High Signal Tower
summary: The highest bastion of the military complex. An iron tower overlooking both the garrison courtyard and the outer village.
inspect_text: A massive parabolic mirror and carbon-arc signal lamp stand ready to flash coded flashes across the underground kingdom.
feature_inspect: A heavy brass projector with geared elevation cranks and a silvered glass reflector.

title: Southwest Steam Bastion
summary: A fortified corner tower bristling with high-pressure steam cannons mounted on swivel carriages.
inspect_text: Heavy iron plating protects the gunners. Compressed steam hoses feed directly from the central boilers.
feature_inspect: A heavy brass-jacketed barrel fitted with a quick-action ball valve and pressure reservoir.

title: Southeast Steam Bastion
summary: The twin corner bastion, commanding clear fields of fire across the eastern village approach road.
inspect_text: Ammo lockers hold racks of solid steel bolts designed to be fired in rapid bursts by steam pressure.
feature_inspect: Heavy pointed steel projectiles arranged in brass feeding clips.

title: West Rampart Walk
summary: A stone-and-iron battlewalk atop the western curtain wall, guarded by pacing soldiers in polished breastplates.
inspect_text: Braziers of coke burn in iron baskets, cutting through the cavern chill.
feature_inspect: A stout iron basket glowing hot with burning anthracite coal.

title: Guard Armory
summary: A secure chamber lined with racks of crossbows, halberds, and reinforced brass shields.
inspect_text: An armorer's anvil stands in the corner, ringed by hammers and tongs for field repairs.
feature_inspect: Neatly slotted wall racks holding military heavy crossbows with steel prods.

title: West Soldier Barracks
summary: A tidy room of double-tiered iron bunkbeds and footlockers for the garrison's watchmen.
inspect_text: Uniforms hang neatly on wall pegs. The floor is scrubbed stone, smelling of floor wax and gun oil.
feature_inspect: An iron-bound wooden chest stenciled with the company regimental insignia.

title: Sentry Post West
summary: An enclosed observation cupola with narrow glass slit-windows looking out over the village roofs.
inspect_text: A brass speaking-tube connects directly to the officer's command desk.
feature_inspect: A polished brass trumpet mouthpiece with an attached whistle stopper.

title: Northwest Rampart Walk
summary: The upper rampart near the apex, where the wall joins the natural rock roof of the cavern.
inspect_text: Steam conduits run along the parapet walk to prevent ice accumulation from upper drafts.
feature_inspect: A small copper tracer pipe wrapped in insulation alongside the stone battlement.

title: Northeast Rampart Walk
summary: The eastern high battlewalk overlooking the deep mine approach drifts.
inspect_text: Guards patrol with mechanical clockwork chronometers strapped to their belts to log their rounds.
feature_inspect: A brass case clock with a rotating paper dial punched by patrol keys.

title: Officer's Quarters
summary: A comfortable room with wool rugs, mahogany lockers, and decanters of imported brandy.
inspect_text: Framed maps of the three concentric triangles hang on the wall, showing mine output projections.
feature_inspect: A detailed topographical map showing chalk vein thickness and daily quota targets.

title: East Soldier Barracks
summary: A second dormitory for off-duty soldiers, filled with the snores of tired sentries.
inspect_text: Boot scrapers and umbrella stands sit beside the door; wool blankets cover every bunk.
feature_inspect: A sturdy angle-iron bed frame fitted with a straw paillasse and wool blanket.

title: Sentry Post East
summary: An elevated watch-station monitoring the eastern rail approaches and tailing dumps.
inspect_text: A trip-wire alarm bell hangs overhead, linked to sensors along the outer perimeter wall.
feature_inspect: A bronze bell with an electric clapper wired to external trip-cords.

title: East Rampart Walk
summary: The lower eastern parapet leading down toward the southeast bastion.
inspect_text: Stacked boxes of quick-lime and chalk-resistant grease sit covered beneath waterproof canvas tarps.
feature_inspect: Heavy waxed canvas lashed tight over military provisions.

title: Timber Stockade East
summary: Heavy vertical iron-sheathed logs form the outer palisade wall facing the village approach.
inspect_text: Crossbow slits cut at chest height provide defensive cover for defenders inside.
feature_inspect: Solid pine trunk clad in quarter-inch boiler plate.

title: Drill Grounds
summary: A cleared courtyard of packed earth where soldiers drill with halberds and practice formations.
inspect_text: Wooden training dummies with notched cuirasses stand along the wall.
feature_inspect: A heavily scarred pine post fitted with straw arms and iron helmet.

title: The Brass Bulkhead Gate
summary: The monumental front portal of the garrison. Two towering doors of solid brass, three feet thick, seal the complex.
inspect_text: Operated by massive hydraulic pistons and gear-wheels. The gate requires official clearance to open.
feature_inspect: Gleaming brass doors stamped with company serial numbers, locked with four hydraulic deadbolts.

title: Guard Mess Hall
summary: A large dining hall with long wooden trestle tables smelling of roast mutton, cabbage, and stale ale.
inspect_text: Tin plates and pewter tankards sit drying on dish racks beside a large cast-iron cookstove.
feature_inspect: A six-burner range with two baking ovens, radiating heat day and night.

title: Steam Smithy
summary: A roaring workshop equipped with a steam trip-hammer, two open forges, and quench tubs.
inspect_text: The blacksmith hammers glowing iron bars into replacement piston rods and prison bars.
feature_inspect: A half-ton iron hammerhead driven rapidly up and down by an overhead steam cylinder.

title: Captain Malik's Headquarters
summary: A grand tent of reinforced sailcloth erected within the inner courtyard, furnished with campaign tables and brass chests.
inspect_text: Captain Malik directs the garrison from here. In a locked brass strongbox on his desk lies the ancient **Teleportation Scroll**.
feature_inspect: A heavy iron-banded chest secured with a complex tumbler lock. Inside lies the Teleportation Scroll.

title: The Iron Prison Cage
summary: A suspended iron cage hanging over a dry stone pit in the shadow of the central Calcinator.
inspect_text: Inside sits **Zayd (age 11)**, dirty-faced and furious, gripping the iron bars and yelling at his captors. Nearby stands the silent, robed **Priest Harun**.
feature_inspect: Heavy vertical iron bars riveted to a solid hoop frame. Zayd is trapped inside, waiting for the gate.

title: The Great Chalk Calcinator
summary: The beating industrial heart of the floor: an enormous spherical brass boiler twenty feet in diameter, wrapped in steam pipes.
inspect_text: Crushed chalk ore is fed into top hoppers and super-heated by high-pressure steam, vaporizing it into glowing white aether-vapor that feeds the teleport gate.
feature_inspect: A titanic brass pressure vessel vibrating with deafening power, venting luminescent steam through copper conduits.

title: The Teleportation Gate
summary: A colossal archway of polished basalt and brass, wrapped in thick copper cables that pulse with blinding white light.
inspect_text: The arch frames an unstable, swirling white vortex powered by vaporized chalk from the Calcinator. This is the gateway to **Floor 5**.
feature_inspect: A roaring oval of pure luminous white energy, tearing through space down toward Floor 5.
